build_iceberg_dataset: build an IcebergDataset from a metadata path or PyIceberg Table object with optional snapshot and storage properties
create_iceberg_scan: create a Polars LazyFrame scan from an Iceberg table with projection, limit, and pyarrow predicate filtering
test_iceberg_schema: test the IcebergDataset schema and arrow_schema methods to fetch the PyArrow schema of an Iceberg table
refactor_iceberg_fallback: refactor the IcebergDataset scan to fallback to pyiceberg reader when native parquet scan is unsupported
summarize_storage_options: summarize the _convert_iceberg_to_object_store_storage_options function that maps Iceberg config keys to object store options
